native_release_decisions_pending: The reference promises OS families and Python >=3.11, but no explicit native architecture, libc, deployment-target or free-threading matrix. M1 packaging must preserve these source-install promises and qualify every added native wheel tag.
policy: Configured CI lanes are requirements, not passing evidence. Local macOS arm64 results do not qualify every macos-latest runner or Linux. Do not infer native portability from the pure-Python wheel tag.
native_policy: Do not narrow existing Python >=3.11/macOS/Linux support. Wheel tags, abi3 choice, CPU baseline and source-build prerequisites are M1 design decisions requiring tested artifacts; observed CI machines are not an exhaustive support declaration.
